name: Severance
blurb: Office workers whose memories are surgically split between work and home start asking why
title: Severance Recap: Seasons 1 and 2 and the Ending Explained
description: Severance recap: the main characters, what happens in seasons 1 and 2 at Lumon Industries, the season 2 ending explained, and the status of season 3.
h1: Severance Recap: Seasons 1 and 2 and the Ending Explained
answer: Severance is an American psychological thriller series created by Dan Erickson, with most episodes directed by executive producer Ben Stiller. Season 1 aired in 2022 and season 2 in early 2025; season 3 was ordered in March 2025, began filming in July 2026 and had no release date as of November 2026. Employees of the biotech company Lumon Industries have undergone severance, a brain procedure that splits their memories: the work self, or innie, knows nothing of life outside, and the home self, or outie, knows nothing of work. The story follows Mark Scout and his team in the Macrodata Refinement department as they start to wonder what their job really is.

head: Character
Who they are
rows: A former history professor, widowed, who took a severed job at Lumon to escape his grief
A new hire in Mark's department who wants out from her first minute
Mark's coworker, who lives for the department's small prizes and perks
A by-the-book veteran of the department, devoted to Lumon's rules
The manager of the severed floor, cold and secretive
The gentle head of the Optics and Design department
Mark's sister, who has doubts about his job
Mark's best friend at work, who left Lumon suddenly

ol: Season 1 (2022, 9 episodes): Petey leaves Lumon without warning, and Mark is made head of Macrodata Refinement (MDR), where the team sorts numbers that seem scary into bins without knowing why. Mark trains the new hire, Helly, who tries again and again to resign; her outie answers with a video refusing. Outside, Petey finds Mark and claims his memories were reunited by a rogue doctor, Reghabi; he falls ill and dies. Mark's next-door neighbor, Mrs. Selvig, is secretly Cobel, spying on him. Helly tries to hang herself in the elevator and survives. Irving falls for Burt, and the MDR team discovers that another department, Optics and Design, is far larger than they were told. The innies learn of the overtime contingency, a switch that wakes innies in the outside world. In the finale Dylan holds it open: Mark's innie wakes at a party at Devon's house, Irving's innie tracks down Burt and finds him at home with a husband, and Helly's innie wakes at a Lumon gala and learns she is Helena Eagan, daughter of Lumon's CEO, and tells the crowd how innies are treated. Mark's innie sees a photo and realizes that Ms. Casey is his wife, Gemma, whom he believed had died in a car crash. Milchick tackles Dylan and the switch closes.

Season 2 (2025, 10 episodes): The innies return to find the uprising has made them the public face of severance reform. Helly comes back too, but at the end of a company retreat it is revealed that this was Helena, the outie, posing as her innie; the real innie Helly then returns. Mark's outie, now knowing Gemma is alive, has Reghabi start reversing his severance, which causes seizures. Irving's innie is fired, and his outie, who has been investigating Lumon, is later put on a train out of town by Burt. Dylan's outie wife Gretchen visits his innie at work. Cobel, pushed out by Lumon, returns to her home town of Salt's Neck, where evidence shows she invented the severance chip. Milchick takes over the floor. Meanwhile Gemma is held on a hidden testing floor; each file Mark's team completes creates and tests a new innie version of her, and the last file, Cold Harbor, will end the experiment and her life.

body: In the season 2 finale, Cold Harbor, Mark's innie and outie talk through recorded videos. The outie wants to rescue Gemma and expose Lumon; the innie knows that full reintegration could end his own existence and Helly's. He finishes the Cold Harbor file with Helly beside him, then, with Dylan and Helly holding back Milchick and the staff, heads for the testing floor. There Mark accidentally kills Mr. Drummond, a Lumon executive, with a cattle stunner, and uses Drummond's blood on his tie to pass the biometric lock and free Gemma. On the severed floor his innie leads Gemma to the exit stairwell, where she becomes her outside self. Mark's innie does not follow her: he turns back and runs off down the hallway with Helly as alarms sound.

ul: Two selves, two loves: Dan Erickson has described the ending as a choice between two loves and two identities, showing that Mark's innie is as real a person as his outie.
Not a cliffhanger by design: Ben Stiller has said he wanted a natural end point after season 1's sudden stop, while still leaving open what Lumon will do next.
Open questions for season 3: what Cold Harbor proves for Lumon, why Gemma and Mark were chosen, and what happens to an innie who refuses to leave.

body.note: Status as of November 2026: season 3 was renewed in March 2025 and began filming in July 2026; no premiere date has been announced. This page covers only the two seasons that have aired.

ul: Work-life balance taken literally: severance turns the wish to leave work at the office into two separate people, one of whom never goes home.
Identity: the innies are full people with friends and feelings, and the show asks who has the right to decide their lives.
Grief: Mark chose severance to spend eight hours a day without missing Gemma, and the plot turns that grief into Lumon's experiment.
Corporate worship: Lumon treats its founder Kier Eagan as a prophet, with rituals, rewards and punishments that keep workers obedient.
Consent and control: the outies agree to the procedure, but the innies never did, and every escape attempt tests that gap.
Length: two seasons so far, 19 episodes of about 40 to 75 minutes; season 3 is in production with no release date.
Original language: English. Filmed mainly in New York and New Jersey.
Pacing: slow and deliberate, with mysteries revealed gradually; the story is serialized and must be watched in order.
Content: a suicide attempt, psychological torment in the break room, some violence and a few disturbing medical scenes.

check.q: What does the severance procedure do?
options: It erases a worker's past for good
It splits memories between work and life outside work
It lets workers read each other's minds
check.why: Severed employees have a work self and a home self who share no memories.

check.q: Who does Mark discover Ms. Casey really is?
check.why: At the end of season 1, Mark's innie sees a photo and realizes Ms. Casey is Gemma, the wife he thought was dead.

check.q: What does Mark's innie do at the end of season 2?
options: He frees Gemma but stays behind and runs off with Helly
check.why: After guiding Gemma out, the innie chooses to stay and runs off with Helly.

faq.q: When does Severance season 3 come out?
faq.a: No date has been announced as of November 2026. Apple renewed the show in March 2025, and filming began in July 2026.

faq.q: What is Cold Harbor in Severance?
faq.a: It is the last file Mark's team must refine. Each file has tested a new innie version of Gemma, and Cold Harbor is the final test, after which Lumon planned to remove her chip, which would kill her.

faq.q: How many episodes of Severance are there?
faq.a: Nineteen so far: nine in season 1 (2022) and ten in season 2 (2025).
